_comment: The pinned identity of the sharded corpus released with arXiv:2505.06120.
The payload itself is 28.9 MB and is NOT committed; `de fetch` downloads it
and decision_evals.corpora.verify() refuses anything that does not match.
Upstream is a live main branch, so the commit pin is what makes 'we ran the
published corpus' checkable rather than hopeful. Do not re-pin this file to
silence a hash mismatch -- find out what changed upstream first.
